title: The Empty Shop
subtitle: The ration shop runs out on the third day of the month; the dealer is accused of selling the grain
coldOpen: 08:00. The ration shop has no grain on the third.

briefing.grievance: Two hundred families with ration cards have no grain on the third of the month. They say the dealer sells it to the mill at night. The dealer says the godown sent half the allotment.
knownFacts: The shop’s allotment this month is 9 tonnes for 1,100 cards.
The dealer’s stock register shows 9 tonnes received and 9 tonnes issued in two days.
The e-POS machine was offline for both days.
unverifiedClaims: A post shows sacks “from the shop” being loaded at a mill.
The dealer says the godown truck arrived half empty.
briefing.responsibility: You run the district supply office. The cards are real; so is the hunger by the tenth.
briefing.objective: Get grain to the cardholders this week, find where nine tonnes went with evidence, and fix the system that let it vanish.

evidence.title: Allotment and stock register
evidence.claim: Allotment 9 t; register shows 9 t received on the 1st and 9 t issued to 1,100 cards by the 2nd; e-POS offline both days.

visual.caption: A register with two neat days

evidence.resolutionNote: Nine tonnes to eleven hundred cards in two days, with the machine off, is a story not a record.

evidence.resolutionNote: The dealer signed for nine tonnes; the half-empty truck story fails here.

options.consequence: The queue hears you doubt the register too.

options.title: Police the shutter; disperse the queue
options.preview: The kicking stops; so does the queue.
options.authority: Article 19(2)–(3): restrictions must be reasonable and specific
options.consequence: Hungry people are dispersed from an empty shop.

delayed.message: The crackdown hardens people who had stayed out of it. More arrive, angrier.

options.title: Tell them to come back next month

rightsMoments.question: Grain meant for 1,100 cardholders has vanished and the dealer is suspected. What does the right to food require of the administration?

options.text: Restore supply immediately, investigate with evidence, suspend and prosecute through due process, and fix the system failure that allowed the diversion.
options.feedback: Correct. The right to food is met by delivery first; accountability follows evidence and process.

options.text: Arrest the dealer on the viral clip; the hungry cannot wait for evidence.
options.feedback: The hungry need grain, not an arrest; an arrest on false evidence collapses and the real diversion continues.

options.text: Record the register as correct; the system says the grain was issued.
options.feedback: A register contradicted by the people it names is not a record; the right to food is not satisfied on paper.

rightsMoments.principle: The right to food (Article 21, the National Food Security Act) requires actual delivery; diversion is answered by evidence-led prosecution and systemic fixes, not by paper or by spectacle.
rightsMoments.why: A buffer truck in the afternoon and a sealed DVR by night fed the queue and built the case; a midnight arrest on a clip would have done neither.

source.label: Constitution of India, Articles 21 and 22 (India Code)

simple.question: Grain for 1,100 families has vanished and the dealer is suspected. What must the state do?

options.a: Send grain now. Investigate with proof. Suspend and prosecute fairly. Fix the system.
options.b: Arrest the dealer on the viral clip. The hungry cannot wait.
options.c: Trust the register. It says the grain was given.

feedback.a: Yes! Feed people first, then follow the evidence.
feedback.b: No. Hungry people need grain, not an arrest on a fake clip.
feedback.c: A register the people deny is not proof.

simple.principle: Food is a right. Deliver it first, then follow the evidence and fix the hole.
simple.why: A truck in the afternoon and a sealed camera copy by night fed the queue and built the case.

rightsProtected.simple: A case was built on real proof.

rightsHarmed.simple: An arrest ran ahead of the proof.

rightsHarmed.simple: Hungry people were policed instead of fed.

closing.good: The queue ate by afternoon, the DVR is sealed, the dealer has a hearing date, and “offline” now needs a witness.
closing.mixed: Grain arrived and the dealer is suspended, but the footage is gone and the case rests on the tally alone.
closing.poor: The queue was dispersed or the godown looted, and the nine tonnes are officially accounted for.
